Record Class Vector2Dd

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
nl.pim16aap2.animatedarchitecture.core.util.vector.Vector2Dd
public record Vector2Dd(double x, double y) extends Record
Represents a double x/y pair.

This class is thread-safe, as all modifications return a new instance.
